scientific_integrity: The exact integer transfer and its scalar moment generating function are proved algebraically; finite checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite identities or any novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Only A383066 sampled over complete dyadic rows. No claim of a normalized limiting distribution or general higher-moment laws. The 2024 precursor constructs the same sequence and provides earlier first moments. Unidentified broader moment-theorems remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact quadratic dyadic moments and exponential relative dispersion of a divisor-counting sequence
